---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability, language profile, or pipeline improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem / Use Case
Describe the limitation or workflow gap you are trying to solve (e.g., a missing language profile, stylized lyric layout, or Web UI workflow).

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you would like this to work (e.g., CLI flag, `lang.py` / `config.py` enhancement, OCR preprocessing, or `.lrc` export option).

## Alternatives Considered
Mention any workarounds or alternative designs you considered.

## Additional Context
If proposing a language or script improvement, please include a few representative lyric lines (and whether the video uses parallel bilingual subtitles).
